## Investment Thesis
Eli Lilly is the co-leader of the historic metabolic health revolution. Together with Novo Nordisk, the company commands a duopoly in GLP-1 therapies (Mounjaro for diabetes, Zepbound for obesity) which represent a multi-decade structural growth wave. LLY has demonstrated stellar execution in scaling its manufacturing capacity, particularly in sterile fill-finish operations, creating a massive capital barrier to entry for prospective competitors. 

Furthermore, LLY's pipeline extends into major categories such as Alzheimer's Disease (Donanemab) and next-generation oral GLP-1s (Orforglipron), securing its long-term runway. Operating margins have surged from ~15% in FY2022 to nearly 35% TTM due to product mix shifted towards high-margin GLP-1s and substantial operating leverage.
